name: JDC Corporation
summary: JDC Corporation engages in the construction business in Japan and Asia. The company is involved in the construction of dams, bridges, tunnels, roads, water supply and sewerage, landfills, stadiums, office buildings, apartments, and logistics facilities; and architectural design and business planning, building value regeneration, and food factory and seismic isolation engineering solutions. It also engages in the manufacture, sale, repair, and rental of construction and mining machinery; provision of coal ash mixed materials, refuse concrete, acetic acid absorbents, and adhesives; and operation of agricultural solar power plants and cemeteries.
